files.README.md:
# BI dashboard builder

Designs star schemas and DAX measures for dashboards.

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/datapulse/bi-dashboard-builder
claude --plugin-dir ./bi-dashboard-builder
```

## License

See the LICENSE file.

# Star Schema
